Gemini AI Configuration (Required for generation)

API Connection

To generate minutes of meeting directly in your browser, enter your Gemini API Key. You can get a free key from Google AI Studio.

Method A: Google Apps Script (Recommended - No Cloud Setup)

Zero Config

Creates documents directly in your Google Drive using a simple Apps Script. No Google Cloud APIs or console setup required.

Quick 3-Minute Setup Instructions:
  1. Go to script.google.com and click New Project.
  2. Replace the entire script with this code:
  3. Click Deploy > New deployment. Select Web app as type. Set Execute as: Me and Who has access: Anyone.
  4. Click Deploy, authorize permissions, copy the Web App URL and paste it above!

Method B: Google Drive API (OAuth Consent Screen)

Standard OAuth

Authorizes credentials natively in the browser. Requires creating a Google Cloud OAuth Client ID with Authorized JavaScript Origins set to your origin.

Important: Google OAuth (Method B) does not support direct local file access (URLs starting with file://). Since this generator is opened directly as a file, please use Method A (Google Apps Script Web App) instead, which works perfectly for local/offline files!
